Their love had acquired the majestic importance of acknowledged fact, and from five to seven had taken refuge in the fifth floor of the rue de la Pompe where Julio had an artist’s studio.

arxiv-2107-07757.title: Entropic alternatives to initialization
arxiv-2107-07757.creator: Daniele Musso
arxiv-2107-07757.description: Abstract Local entropic loss functions provide a versatile framework to define architecture-aware regularization procedures. Besides the possibility of being anisotropic in the synaptic space, the local entropic smoothening of the loss function can vary during training, thus yielding a tunable model complexity.

arxiv-2109-10889.title: General Space-Time Tradeoffs via Relational Queries
arxiv-2109-10889.creator: Shaleen Deep, Xiao Hu, Paraschos Koutris
arxiv-2109-10889.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shaleen Deep, Xiao Hu, Paraschos Koutris. In this paper, we investigate space-time tradeoffs for answering Boolean conjunctive queries. The goal is to create a data structure in an initial preprocessing phase and use it for answering (multiple) queries. Previous work has developed data structures that trade off space usage for answering time and has proved conditional space lower bounds for queries of practical interest such as the path and triangle query.

arxiv-2304-12978.title: Singly generated Selfadjoint-Ideal operator semigroups: spectral density of the generator and simplicity
arxiv-2304-12978.creator: Sasmita Patnaik*, Sanehlata, Gary Weiss**
arxiv-2304-12978.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sasmita Patnaik*, Sanehlata, Gary Weiss**. This extends our new study of the automatic selfadjoint ideal property for B ⁡ ( ℋ ) B(\mathcal{H}) -operator semigroups introduced to us by Heydar Radjavi (SI semigroups for short). Our investigation here of singly generated SI semigroups led to unexpected algebraic and analytic phenomena on the simplicity of SI semigroups and on the spectral density of their generators.

arxiv-2306-01099.title: Mean field limit for one dimensional opinion dynamics with Coulomb interaction and time dependent weights
arxiv-2306-01099.creator: Immanuel Ben-Porat, José A. Carrillo, Sondre T. Galtung
arxiv-2306-01099.description: Abstract The mean field limit with time dependent weights for a 1D singular case, given by the attractive Coulomb interactions, is considered. This extends recent results [ 1 , 8 ] for the case of regular interactions. The approach taken here is based on transferring the kinetic target equation to a Burgers-type equation through the distribution function of the measures.

arxiv-2405-01815.title: Toward end-to-end interpretable convolutional neural networks for waveform signals
arxiv-2405-01815.creator: Linh Vu, Thu Tran, Lim Wern Han, Raphaël C.-W. Phan
arxiv-2405-01815.description: Abstract This paper introduces a novel convolutional neural networks (CNN) framework tailored for end-to-end audio deep learning models, presenting advancements in efficiency and explainability. By benchmarking experiments on three standard speech emotion recognition datasets with five-fold cross-validation, our framework outperforms Mel spectrogram features by up to seven percent. It can potentially replace the Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) while remaining lightweight.

arxiv-2405-04302.title: On the existence and uniqueness of weak solutions to elliptic equations with a singular drift
arxiv-2405-04302.creator: Misha Chernobai, Tim Shilkin
arxiv-2405-04302.description: Abstract In this paper we study the Dirichlet problem for a scalar elliptic equation in a bounded Lipschitz domain Ω ⊂ ℝ 3 \Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^{3} with a singular drift of the form b 0 = b − α ​ x ′ | x ′ | 2 b_{0}=b-\alpha\frac{x^{\prime}}{|x^{\prime}|^{2}} where x ′ = ( x 1 , x 2 , 0 ) x^{\prime}=(x_{1},x_{2},0)

arxiv-2408-00040.title: Barlow Twins Deep Neural Network for Advanced 1D Drug–Target Interaction Prediction
arxiv-2408-00040.creator: Maximilian G. Schuh, Davide Boldini, Annkathrin I. Bohne, Stephan A. Sieber
arxiv-2408-00040.description: Abstract Accurate prediction of drug–target interactions is critical for advancing drug discovery. By reducing time and cost, machine learning and deep learning can accelerate this laborious discovery process. In a novel approach, BarlowDTI , we utilise the powerful Barlow Twins architecture for feature-extraction while considering the structure of the target protein.

arxiv-2409-12194.title: Gender Representation and Bias in Indian Civil Service Mock Interviews
arxiv-2409-12194.creator: Somonnoy BanerjeeRochester Institute of Technology sb7238@rit.edu, Sujan DuttaRochester Institute of Technology sd2516@rit.edu Soumyajit DattaRochester Institute of Technology sd3528@rit.edu Ashiqur R. KhudaBukhshRochester Institute of Technology axkvse@rit.edu
arxiv-2409-12194.description: Abstract This paper makes three key contributions. First, via a substantial corpus of 51,278 interview questions sourced from 888 YouTube videos of mock interviews of Indian civil service candidates, we demonstrate stark gender bias in the broad nature of questions asked to male and female candidates.

arxiv-2412-17751.title: Group Testing with General Correlation Using Hypergraphs
arxiv-2412-17751.creator: Hesam Nikpey, Saswati Sarkar, Shirin Saeedi Bidokhti
arxiv-2412-17751.description: Abstract Group testing, a problem with diverse applications across multiple disciplines, traditionally assumes independence across nodes’ states. Recent research, however, focuses on real-world scenarios that often involve correlations among nodes, challenging the simplifying assumptions made in existing models. In this work, we consider a comprehensive model for arbitrary statistical correlation among nodes’ states.

arxiv-2505-03795.title: Modeling Human Behavior in a Strategic Network Game with Complex Group Dynamics
arxiv-2505-03795.creator: Jonathan Skaggs, Jacob W. Crandall
arxiv-2505-03795.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jonathan Skaggs, Jacob W. Crandall. Human networks greatly impact important societal outcomes, including wealth and health inequality, poverty, and bullying. As such, understanding human networks is critical to learning how to promote favorable societal outcomes. As a step toward better understanding human networks, we compare and contrast several methods for learning models of human behavior in a strategic network game called the Junior High Game (JHG) ( Skaggs et al., 2024 ) .

arxiv-2507-17550.title: Photometric Mapping of Carbonaceous/Siliceous Dust and Water Ice in the ISM with JWST: Applications to the Dense Sightlines Released on xxx, 1st, 2025 Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) , SciPy ( Virtanen et al. 2020
arxiv-2507-17550.creator: Burcu Günay, Karl D. Gordon, Joshua E. G. Peek, Marjorie Decleir, Dries Van De Putte, Kirill Tchernyshyov, Michael G. Burton
arxiv-2507-17550.description: Abstract We introduce a new photometric mapping method for the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) to measure the spatial distribution of carbonaceous dust, siliceous dust and water ice by using absorption features arising from the grains in the dense interstellar medium (ISM).

carolinian.title: Carolinian
carolinian.creator: Sabatini, Rafael
carolinian.description: Excitement and anticipation are rife in the New World – it is a land offering new beginnings and new opportunities. Yet it is also a land of intrigue, deception and deadly opposition. Centred on the rich and fertile soils of Carolina at the time of the American War of Independence, 'The Carolinian 'charts the interwoven stories of a host of characters.

pmc-10498557.description: BackgroundLow back pain (LBP) has drawn much widespread attention and is a major global health concern. pmc-10701749.creator: Chenglong Cao, Mingwu Li, Min Wu, Xiaofeng Jiang
pmc-10701749.description: BACKGROUNDTrigeminal neuralgia (TN) is a common neurosurgical issue that has a detrimental impact on patients’ quality of life. Osteoma at the petrous apex is a rare etiology of TN. Here, the authors present a case involving the co-occurrence of petrous osteoma and a vascular loop around the trigeminal nerve.

pmc-11436196.description: 1,3-Butadiene (BD) is classified as a human carcinogen, and occupational exposure should be minimized. This study examined the effectiveness of personal protective equipment (PPE) during the clean-up and repair of a storage tank containing sludge contaminated with BD. A total of 66 workers participated, providing repeat urine samples before and after the shift.

pmc-13091636.description: BackgroundSocial frailty is a critical indicator of declining social functioning and affects quality of life in older adults.
